quote: Just disenchanted 5 ilvl 630 blues and recived 8-12 dust from each one.
notes: Post-November 25, 2014 hotfix anecdote: 5 separate rare-quality ilvl-630 gear disenchants each yielded 8–12 Draenic Dust. Each of the five was material-positive, but the five individual stack sizes, total units, item IDs, skill/spec and exact client build are absent; historical only. No overall zero-output outcomes inferred.

quote: My very small sample (read: not very accurate data) of 40 rings gave 6 shards.
notes: First-person followup of 40 completed disenchant attempts on crafted Blackrock Band rings (three possible variants; exact item ID not stated); six total Luminous Shard items reported. Number of shard-positive casts, joint dust outcomes, zero bins, per-cast stack histogram, gear variant, and skill/build unknown. Historical ring ilvl 585 is stated elsewhere in the same comment. Do not turn six output units into six hits.

quote: Rare (blue) quality items now have a greatly increased chance to disenchant into Draenic Dust
notes: Official Blizzard archive lists under November 25, 2014. Historic WoD rare items become more likely to give 109693 instead of Small Luminous Shard; enchanting profession yields more 109693. No official numeric percentage or player-cast denominator. This is not proof of current Retail item eligibility.
affects: Warlords rare-quality blue equipment: Draenic Dust 109693 versus Small Luminous Shard; enchanting profession quantity effect
wording: Rare (blue) quality items now have a greatly increased chance to disenchant into Draenic Dust instead of a Small Luminous Shard.
